Surya Namaskar is a sequence of 12 powerful yoga asanas [PROG_Y_001]. It is best performed early morning on an empty stomach [PROG_Y_001]. 

Ek complete round consists of two sets, starting with the right leg and then the left [PROG_Y_001]. Each posture is coordinated with your breath [PROG_Y_001].

People with high blood pressure, hernia, or back problems should consult a doctor or certified instructor before performing it [PROG_Y_001].

Anulom Vilom Pranayama mind ko calm karne aur stress relieve karne ke liye ek powerful pranayama hai [PROG_P_001]. Yeh body mein Tridoshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) ko balance karne mein help karta hai [PROG_P_001]. Isse patience aur concentration bhi improve hota hai [PROG_P_001].

Healthy lifestyle ke liye ek balanced diet zaroori hai jisme carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, aur minerals ho [PROG_D_001]. 

Breakfast mein fried foods ki jagah poha, upma, ya idli lein [PROG_D_001]. Lunch mein 2 rotis, ek bowl dal, sabzi, aur salad khayein [PROG_D_001]. Dinner sabse halka hona chahiye, jisme khichdi ya dal ke sath vegetable stir-fry ek accha option hai [PROG_D_001]. Cravings ke liye nuts aur seeds snack karein [PROG_D_001], aur processed sugar aur excessive salt se bachein [PROG_D_001]. 

Roz kam se kam 8-10 glasses of paani (water) zaroor piyein [PROG_D_001, PROG_D_003].

Kapalbhati, or Skull Shining Breath, is an invigorating pranayama that cleanses the body through active, forceful exhalation and passive inhalation [PROG_P_002]. Sit comfortably with a straight spine, take a deep breath in, and exhale in short, powerful bursts while your stomach pumps inwards [PROG_P_002]. 

Start with a round of 20-30 pumps, and you can do up to 3 rounds with breaks [PROG_P_002]. It stimulates the digestive system, improves metabolic rate, and aids in weight loss [PROG_P_002]. Perform this on an empty stomach, preferably in the morning [PROG_P_002]. Avoid it if you are pregnant, have high blood pressure, heart disease, hernia, or epilepsy [PROG_P_002].

Trikonasana, or Triangle Pose, is a foundational standing pose that stretches the entire body [PROG_Y_003]. To do it, stand with your feet wide apart, turn your right foot out 90 degrees and your left foot in slightly [PROG_Y_003]. Inhale, and as you exhale, extend your torso to the right, bending from the hips and placing your right hand on your shin, ankle, or the floor while extending your left arm up [PROG_Y_003]. It stretches the hamstrings, hips, and spine, strengthens legs and core, helps with stress, and improves digestion [PROG_Y_003]. Avoid if you have a headache, low blood pressure, or a neck injury, and dont lock your knees [PROG_Y_003]. Hold for 30-60 seconds [PROG_Y_003].

Garmi ke liye aap Sheetali Pranayama (Cooling Breath) kar sakte hain [PROG_P_004]. Isme apni tongue ko tube shape mein roll karke mouth se bahar nikalte hain aur straw ki tarah slow aur deep inhale karte hain [PROG_P_004]. Phir tongue andar karke mouth close karte hain aur nostrils se slow exhale karte hain [PROG_P_004]. Isse body par cooling effect padta hai aur hunger and thirst control karne mein help milti hai [PROG_P_004]. Isko 5-10 times repeat kar sakte hain [PROG_P_004]. 

Contraindications: Ye low blood pressure ya respiratory issues jaise asthma wale logo ke liye recommended nahi hai [PROG_P_004]. Clean environment mein practice karein [PROG_P_004].

Apni immunity (Rog Pratirodhak Chhamata) badhane ke liye ek balanced diet leni chahiye [PROG_D_002]. 

Citrus fruits jaise amla, oranges, aur lemons mein Vitamin C hota hai jo immunity booster hai [PROG_D_002]. Turmeric (haldi) mein curcumin hota hai, ise milk ya curries mein add karein [PROG_D_002]. Ginger aur garlic bhi bahut faydemand hain [PROG_D_002]. 

Yogurt gut health ke liye achha source hai [PROG_D_002]. Green leafy vegetables jaise spinach (palak) antioxidants se packed hoti hain, aur almonds Vitamin E ka achha source hain [PROG_D_002].

Yogi Devvrat is a certified RYT 500 Yoga Alliance instructor with over 15 years of experience, having started his journey in Rishikesh under traditional yoga gurus [PROG_I_001]. His style combines classical Hatha yoga with modern Vinyasa flow, focusing on alignment and breath, and he specializes in therapeutic yoga to help manage chronic pain and stress-related ailments [PROG_I_001].

Millets are ancient grains that are gluten-free and rich in fiber, protein, and antioxidants [PROG_D_004]. They are considered a modern superfood for a healthy lifestyle [PROG_D_004]. 

Different types offer unique benefits, such as Ragi (Finger Millet) being an excellent source of calcium for bone health, Jowar (Sorghum) being packed with iron and protein, and Bajra (Pearl Millet) being rich in magnesium for heart health [PROG_D_004]. Because they are high in fiber and have a low glycemic index, they aid in weight management and are suitable for diabetics [PROG_D_004].

You can relax using Shavasana (Corpse Pose). Lie flat on your back with your feet apart and arms by your sides, palms facing up. Close your eyes, let go of breath control, and release tension (*thakaan*). Spend 5-10 minutes remaining aware and relaxed [PROG_Y_004]. 

Another option is Balasana (Childs Pose). Kneel, sit back on your heels, and fold forward with your forehead on the floor. Hold for 30 seconds to a few minutes while focusing on deep, diaphragmatic breathing [PROG_Y_005].

Dia Malik is a certified clinical nutritionist with a Masters degree in Food and Nutrition who has helped over 500 clients reach their health goals using a no-deprivation approach [PROG_I_002]. She creates sustainable, personalized meal plans and a khaane ka plan (eating plan) tailored to Indian cuisine and lifestyle [PROG_I_002]. You can book a one-on-one consultation with her on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4 PM to 6 PM [PROG_I_002].

Staying hydrated is crucial for overall health because water regulates body temperature, lubricates joints, and helps deliver nutrients to cells [PROG_D_003]. Dehydration can cause headaches, fatigue, and poor concentration [PROG_D_003]. Aim for 8-10 glasses of water per day, and drink water before meals to aid in weight management by making you feel full [PROG_D_003]. Water is also essential for kidney function and flushing out toxins [PROG_D_003].
